static_traits.name: Lin Rui
static_traits.social_status: Main Social support coming from friends, but hesitating to share troubles for fear of being judged, recently Feels isolated, relationships with friends becoming tense
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; never had similar psychological problems before, also never received psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Skeptical about counseling but able to cooperate in conversation; able to clearly describe experiences and feelings; tending to over-interpret others' words, actions and expressions; avoiding directly expressing unease with jokes / understatement

basic_info.main_problem: Anxiety and Sense of isolation from worrying friends will negatively judge one's sleep habits, feeling Anxious almost daily in recent months when making plans or talking about daily life with friends, and gradually worrying friends will avoid oneself.
basic_info.core_demands: When I noticed Anxiety was already affecting my social interactions and overall well-being, I decided to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Long-term lack of immediate family (no parents or siblings), Social support mainly relying on friends, making one especially sensitive to friends' opinions and relationship quality.

core_beliefs: I am weird / not normal (will therefore be judged by others)
Others will distance themselves from me because of my being different

special_situations.event: After telling a friend about one's sleep schedule, the friend showed surprise
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my routine differs from others', others will think I am strange and look down on me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries hard to justify one's schedule, but reduces further self-disclosure
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am strange, will keep some distance from me

special_situations.event: Friends comment things like 'It is so nice to sleep that late'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others mention my routine, they are secretly judging me as lazy or irresponsible
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Brushes it off with jokes (compliant on the surface, highly tense inside)
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is actually mocking me as lazy, very irresponsible

special_situations.event: When making plans with friends or talking about daily life
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If sleep-schedule differences are mentioned, they will spend less time with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids asking directly about real meanings, reducing self-disclosure to lessen chances of being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will probably start contacting me less

special_situations.event: Observes subtle changes in friends' behavior and expressions
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any tiny change conveys dissatisfaction or contempt toward me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly guessing others' intentions in mind, Reinforcement self-vigilance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This proves they are distancing from me

core_conflict.wish: Desires to be accepted by friends and maintain a stable sense of belonging
defense_goal: Avoiding directly expressing unease and needs to reduce Being rejected risk
Maintains superficial safety in relationships through speculation and self-vigilance
Covering inner Anxiety with a relaxed / joking exterior, avoiding triggering conflicts

object_relations.self_representation: An 'outsider' who may be judged and alienated
object_relations.object_representation: Potentially picky 'judger' friends who will devalue and reject
object_relations.linking_affect: Anxiety, shame, loneliness / sense of being excluded

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When friends mention their schedule (such as 'it must be nice to sleep so late') or show surprise/comments when making plans
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding neutral or ambiguous information as negation and belittling (transference: seeing others as nitpicking judges)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplaying the topic in a joking tone, avoiding expressing real unease; reducing follow-ups and Clarification, quickly Displacing to neutral topics.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When suggested to directly clarify a friend's implied meaning or express one's own feelings
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Worries that direct communication will make the relationship worse, proving that one is indeed disliked
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Declining attempts with 'do not make a fuss' 'this would be awkward'; flat tone, emphasizing keeping surface harmony to end discussion.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feels tense or worried about being misunderstood when talking about one's own feelings and needs
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates direct expression with risk and exposing weakness
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Replacing emotional expression with objective description, restrained tone, avoiding 'I feel......', trying not to touch on current emotional details.

manifestations: No immediate family, long-term reliance on friends as main support
Worrying about being judged and distanced by friends, daring not to communicate directly
Feels isolated in social and daily discussions, hesitant to share
outcomes: Increased subjective sense of isolation, life rhythm and self-care disrupted

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact, corresponding to 'acceptance'.
manifestations: Responding to friends' comments with jokes or understatement without touching real unease
In counseling, uses rational discussion to replace touching present emotions

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worries that 'bringing it up would be awkward', over-weighs the consequences of expressing it
Repressing needs for fear that direct asking will worsen relationships

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Attributing one's own worries about 'laziness / irresponsibility' to friends' thoughts
Interprets neutral expressions or comments as negative judgments

positive_force: Able to actively seek help and enter counseling
Able to identify and discuss automatic thoughts, willing to try alternative Interpretations
Maintains some connection with friends (main source of social support)
Agrees to test thoughts with small-step experiments (willingness to change)
negative_force: Marked mind-reading and future-predicting thinking biases
High sensitivity and shame about differences being judged
Avoiding direct communication, resolving unease with jokes leading to accumulated misunderstandings
Single-source Social support (no immediate family), high dependence on friendships, fragile security
Long-term Anxiety interfering with daily rhythm and Work performance

target_behavior.behavior: Significant anxiety in interpersonal situations with tendency to avoid direct communication (brushing off with jokes / perfunctory remarks)
antecedent: Making plans with friends or discussing daily routines
Hearing comments about the schedule (such as 'it must be nice to sleep so late')
Recalls friends' reactions and expressions after disclosing sleep schedule
target_behavior.core_reason: Worrying about being judged 'weird / lazy' for differing sleep routines, then being distanced (high sensitivity to Being rejected and catastrophic Anticipation)
target_behavior.function: Escaping the potential threat of Being rejected and embarrassment, maintaining surface harmony and Self-protection in relationships
target_behavior.consequence: Increasing misunderstandings, rising Relationship tension and Sense of isolation; disrupted daily rhythm and self-care, Decline in work performance
